findings.evidence: "Put an inferred motive (\"you don't care\", \"you were careless\") in SBI Behavior" and, at line 65, "A Slack thread reply stays visible to channel members but may not notify them" repeat guidance already injected through feedback-mastery and professional-communication.
findings.fix: Remove these two duplicated rules from the agent body and rely on the preloaded skills' motive and channel checks. Retain the distinct review-risk framework, roleplay branches, notification-preview guidance and Cc handling.

findings.evidence: "Cc'ing a manager on feedback reads as escalation even when the tone is soft: flag the Cc in Biggest risk and suggest sending 1:1 first." This mandates the same recommendation even when the escalation is intentional or policy-required.
findings.fix: Flag the Cc as an escalation signal, then check whether it is intentional, policy-required or part of an existing escalation. Recommend private 1:1 delivery first only for informal feedback without those conditions; preserve required recipients and select Biggest risk from the actual context.
